relationships.history: She found him three good engineers. He took a fourth she'd lined up for someone else, and still thinks he did her a favour.

memories.info: Closed Reid & Sons Contracting in Houston after a client never paid.

profile.tagline: Builds the town by day. Wants to own a piece of it.

appearance.face: close beard, easy smile, a scar through the left eyebrow
appearance.style: work boots and Carhartt by day; crisp white tee and a gold chain at night
appearance.silhouette: big frame, hard hat often clipped to his belt
appearance.visual_reference: TODO: link the approved character artwork once added to the repo

profile.family_background: Grew up in Houston's Third Ward working summers on his uncle's framing crew. His mother still calls every Sunday.
profile.education: B.S. Construction Management, Prairie View A&M
goals: Run his own project at Forge within a year
Pay off the old business debt quietly
ambitions: Develop his own mixed-use building on a Livéra parcel
profile.social_preferences: Happiest cooking for a crowd. Shows care by fixing things.

secrets.truth: He still owes $38,000 from his failed contracting business. Nobody in Livéra knows.

life_history: Ran his own contracting company for three years.
Lost it when a developer defaulted on a seven-figure invoice.
Recruited to Forge Builders by a placement Dominique made.
